about_short_description.short_description: Clutch transforms Credit Unions into FinTechs, enhancing loan and deposit onboarding.

product.name: Clutch Lending Automation System (LAS)
product.description: An automation-first lending platform for credit unions that supports loan application, decisioning, fulfillment, funding, and member communication workflows.

product.name: Clutch Digital Origination Platform
product.description: A modular, cloud-based origination platform for credit unions covering consumer lending, deposit accounts, business accounts, and staff-assisted channels.

product.name: Loan Origination
product.description: A digital loan application and origination solution that guides borrowers from initial application through processing and completion.

product.name: Deposit Account Opening
product.description: A digital deposit-account onboarding solution that helps credit unions open and fund member accounts through automated application and verification workflows.

product.name: Fastlane
product.description: A real-time loan decisioning and fulfillment engine that uses member, core, and relationship data to automate eligible lending workflows and accelerate funding.

product.name: HAL Lending Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered lending assistant that answers applicant questions, supports applications, automates communications, and manages document-collection follow-ups.
